releases.body:
opencode-ahp `0.1.4` — AHP 1.0.0 host for opencode v2, published to npm.

**Install** ([README — Install](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/blob/main/README.md#install)):

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-ahp
```

or pin this build: `opencode plugin add opencode-ahp@0.1.4`

## Commits
- [afeb635](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/afeb63577d00801ae96504d629c315b68e6d21b2) Add WSS secure transport support (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [3919393](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/39193932ae081b94125f3e5df59138efaedbe082) Implemented changesets and write-ahead reconciliation (Matt Zinkevicius)
